Mauritius Life: a free multiplayer life game set in Mauritius

Mauritius Life is a free life simulation you play in your web browser, with real players, in a 3D world built from the real map of Mauritius, starting in the bay town of Grand Baie. Choose your look, find a job, climb the career ladder, eat dholl puri at the bazaar, throw house parties, decorate your own home and make friends. More regions of the island open over time.

Every Saturday the whole town gathers for the Fashion Show, and the anonymous Heart Garden lets you say what is on your mind without a name. There is nothing to download. Learn more about Mauritius Life.
